The audacious architecture of this institute is a highlight in Pinheiros. A cultural center with exhibit halls, theaters and workshops.

Dedicated to fostering relationships between Brazil and the United Kingdom through cultural events, a library and a restaurant, although nowadays it's mostly a corporate event venue. The British consulate can be found here.

São Paulo's horse racing and social club dates from 1875. The club is also home to a sports center, a spa, two bars, social areas and a space for large musical events. Definitely one place to go if you want to socialize with the richest…

Ice cream parlor that focuses on locally produced flavors and cones. Flavors swap out daily, with vegan options available. Many surprising choices might be available, such as cupuaçu fruit with chocolate, salty caramel and even beer…

A Japanese-style cafe with unique creations by chef Cesar Yukio. Among its available pastries include a matcha-filled choux cream and a yuzu-shaped candy with yuzu cream, citrus jelly and a chocolate shell.
All-you-can-eat vegetarian Indian buffet at a fixed price. Drinks and desserts can be bought as well.
